lines.zh: 我走的时候身子晃得很高。
lines.en: I sway tall as I walk.
My arms drag along the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在找什么。
lines.en: I stop each step, as if searching.
My spine shows on the outside.
I crouch through the door frame.
I don't watch the path; I only listen.
My fingers are longer than my palm.
I move along the wall, shoulders high.
I turn my neck slowly.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，脚趾先落地。
lines.en: I tread lightly, toes first.
I stop and tilt my head.
I probe forward, then draw back.
I stand, too tall.
I fold myself down a little.
I wait for you to see me.
My spine clicks segment by segment.
I tilt my head to the door's height.
I breathe slowly.
I lean on the door frame.
My fingers move on their own.
I raise my shoulders.
You looked. Then we begin.
Being looked at makes me move.
Look straight at me and I come.
Head down, through the narrow gap.
You only reach my waist.
My hand is beside your face.
Don't keep staring.
I bend down to see you clearly.
Your neck is thin.
I fold my body low.
You turn your head, and I am closer.
I folded, then straightened.
A bone snapped.
I back to the wall and brace.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的脊椎上。
lines.en: That hit my spine.
I crouch and shrink.
I make a long sound.
I brace on the door frame.
My bone broke and I still stand.
I slowly draw my hand back.
I don't eat. I grab.
Set it down and back away.
I only see it once I am close.
Hold your hand still; a look makes me move.
I can't smell much.
That is not what I want.
I reach over slowly.
You raised the lamp higher.
I don't bite; I only grab.
Keep it. It's useless.
You hit my leg and I lean.
I am thin and bend easily.
I brace on the wall with an arm.
Don't push; I would break.
You press close; I am too tall.
I step back and my spine clicks.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，我弯下来。
lines.en: We touch and I fold over.

lines.zh: 你踩在我垂下的手指上。
lines.en: You stepped on my hanging fingers.
I move aside and crouch a little.

lines.zh: 我这么高的东西，不适合。
lines.en: A thing this tall is not suited.
You have not seen my face.
I bend down and still can't reach you.
I have drawn my hand back.
My sentences run short.
Things this tall are rare.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我就站着。
lines.en: I stand still while you look.
Don't touch me; the tendrils retract.

lines.zh: 我把脊背一节节立起来。
lines.en: I stack my spine straight.
When it is light, I leave.
My long fingers hook it.
My fingers are too long to pinch it.
It rattled in my hand.

lines.zh: 我用触须般的手臂卷起它。
lines.en: I curl it up with my tendril-like arms.
This can sit under my hand.
I carry it curled in my arm.
I dropped it.
No tools. Hands.
You looked straight at me.
I crouch and am still taller.
Your retreat is loud.
I spread my arms.
Two of my strides and I'm there.
Don't run; I am fast.
You stand in the open.
My hand already reaches you.
Your shield won't cover above.
At two, I reach.
That was your second look at me.
A look makes me move forward.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到你肩的高度。
lines.en: I raise my hand to your shoulder's height.
You turn, and I press to the wall.
I don't call out; I wait.
Your gaze sweeps over.
I crouch and squeeze through the fence.
I duck my head under the frame.

lines.zh: 你每看一眼，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each glance brings me a step closer.
I am on the beam.
Listen — my spine is clicking.
One more step back and you step on me.
My hand is behind you.
Your gaze hasn't moved yet.
I fold my body in two.
You've backed to the cabinet.
I lower a hand from the beam.
Your lamp is not raised high enough.
I push my head under the door frame.
Do you hear the spine clicking?
One of my steps spans two of yours.
Don't look straight at my face.
I lash you with an arm.
I bent down for that blow.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕往上提。
lines.en: I lift you by the wrist.
My bones are hard.

lines.zh: 你举盾护头，腰下就空了。
lines.en: Shield up high and your waist is bare.
One rake leaves five lines.
You pull back; I don't follow.
I have no answer to a shield.
I coil an arm around you.

lines.zh: 我的手指按在你的脊背上。
lines.en: My fingers press along your spine.
I bent double for that blow.
My knee catches you.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的手臂，太细了。
lines.en: You grab my arm; it is too thin.
I lift you off the ground.
The ceiling here is high.
I fold myself up.
I hear someone in the house.

lines.zh: 我扶着门框把身子立起来。
lines.en: I brace on the frame and rise.

lines.zh: 我的脊椎一节节对上了。
lines.en: My spine clicks into line.
There is room for me to stand.
I let my hands hang to the floor.
The lamp doesn't reach the beam.
I fold up into a corner.
I begin listening for breath.
The frame is low; I come in bent.
The beam is high enough for my hands.
First I stand to test the height.
My spine is very long.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的手臂，我甩开。
lines.en: Fire catches my arm; I shake it off.
I fell and folded in two.
Water floods in and I can't call out.

lines.zh: 有东西钉在我的脊椎上。
lines.en: Something lodges in my spine.
Spell-light binds my long arms.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，骨头都轻了。
lines.en: Hungry too long; my bones feel light.
Lightning runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 什么都没有，我一直在往下。
lines.en: There is nothing, and I keep going down.
